version.benefit_text_en: Free LPG connection with cash assistance of Rs. 1600 for a 14.2 kg cylinder or Rs. 1150 for a 5 kg cylinder, along with a free first LPG refill and stove.
not_checked_en: The applicant must belong to an SC or ST household, PMAY (Gramin), AAY, Most Backward Classes, Tea/Ex-Tea Garden tribes, Forest Dwellers, Island/River Island resident, SECC household, or poor household as per 14-point declaration.
There should not be any other LPG connection in the same household.
